say:1:1012222001:1.text: ... Lorsan, what did you just say?
say:1:1012222001:1.source_cn: 噢呵呵……洛桑，你刚才，叫我什么来着？

say:2:1012222002:1.text: Uh... It's great to see you again, Master Arden.
say:2:1012222002:1.source_cn: 呃，当然是尊敬的雅顿老师。

say:3:1012222003:1.text: Hmm... I must be losing my hearing. I swear I heard you call me an old geezer.
say:3:1012222003:1.source_cn: 嗯……可能是我上了年纪，耳背，我怎么听着是老爷子呢？

say:4:1012222004:1.text: *Nervous laughter*... Yes, you misheard. Anyway, we've been looking for you everywhere, Master Arden. Who knew you were here at the Jade Lake Academy this whole time?
say:4:1012222004:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈……是您听错了。雅顿老师，我们一直在找您！没想到...

say:5:1012222005:1.text: Florabelle was in a bit of a bind, and I was worried about the children.
say:5:1012222005:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔遇到了一些麻烦，我也放心不下这些孩子。

say:7:1012222006:0.text: No wonder the Jade Lake Academy wasn't affected. Both you and Florabelle were here to protect and shield the area.
say:7:1012222006:0.source_cn: 难怪翡湖学院没有受到影响，原来是您和芙拉贝尔在此设下了加护。

say:8:1012222007:1.text: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.
say:8:1012222007:1.source_cn: 和梅林相比，我们两个的加护魔法拙劣粗糙，不值一提。
say:8:1012222007:1.male: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.
say:8:1012222007:1.female: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.

say:9:1012222008:1.text: You seem to know that Eomir is making a mess of the Dark Forest. Why don't you go back and stop him?
say:9:1012222008:1.source_cn: 您似乎早知道伊米尔把丛林搞得一团糟了？那您怎么不早点回...

say:10:1012222009:1.text: Lorsan, I'm too old to fight Eomir... That is not the way. A vision has told me that there are other things I must do.
say:10:1012222009:1.source_cn: 洛桑……我老了，难以和伊米尔抗衡。占卜的结果告诉我，还...

say:11:1012222010:1.text: According to Granny Dahnie, there is a direct way to pray and communicate to Misarte hidden in the Vaduso Mountains. Is this true?
say:11:1012222010:1.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆说，瓦度索山脉中隐藏着直接拜谒弥萨忒的方法。...

say:16:1012222014:1.text: Only there can you see the <style="highlight">true form of the Deer Spirit</style>.

say:17:1012222015:1.text: Journey to Ivoryshade and ask Misarte how the Dark Forest can be saved. This task I set upon you.
say:17:1012222015:1.source_cn: 谒见弥萨忒，向祂询问如何才能拯救薄暮丛林。这是你们眼下...

say:21:1012222019:1.text: I'll be here when you all return.
say:21:1012222019:1.source_cn: 我会在这里等你们回来。
